standard: ITF Rules of Tennis 2026, Appendix I, Type 2: diameter 65.4–68.6 mm; midpoint 67.0 mm.
construction: Two separate optic yellow-green felt halves, bounded by a closed two-lobed S seam. The off-white rubber band is approximately 4.5 mm wide, with latitude offsets corrected for seam slope, recessed up to 0.25 mm. Felt is high-roughness with a baked grain normal map and exported sheen.
approximation: The spherical two-lobed curve approximates a generic tennis seam. Felt fibers are normal detail, without individual silhouette hairs. Band width uses a local tangent approximation to a 4.5 mm spherical offset.
